title: Deductible Basis of the Out-of-Network Visit Share from the Account Ledger
content:
For an Out-of-Network Referral (Referrals & Prior Authorizations), the deductible basis of the out-of-network visit share follows the patient's own ledger on the Patient Financial Account:

1. where the patient's most recent deductible charge is above zero and the remaining deductible is at least that charge, the basis is that charge;
2. where the remaining deductible is above zero but smaller than that charge, or no deductible charge is on the ledger, the basis is the remaining deductible;
3. otherwise the basis is zero.

## Records read

- **Most recent deductible charge**: the amount of the latest charge posted to the Patient Financial Account in the deductible category, latest by transaction date.
- **Remaining deductible**: the remaining deductible recorded on the Patient Financial Account.

## Cases (hypothetical ledgers)

| Most recent deductible charge | Remaining deductible | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| 120.00 | 900.00 | 120.00 — the remaining deductible is at least the charge |
| 120.00 | 120.00 | 120.00 — equal counts as at least |
| 120.00 | 80.00 | 80.00 — the remaining deductible is smaller |
| none on the ledger | 400.00 | 400.00 |
| 120.00 | 0.00 | zero |
| none on the ledger | 0.00 | zero |
